title: Descendant-aware post-exit lifecycle hardening
objective: Harden and qualify the contained Windows executor when the primary child exits while a descendant retains inherited stdout/stderr handles, so post-primary-exit output draining remains bounded, descendant lifecycle is resolved through the Job, and no success result is returned until Job/process-tree quiescence is verified. This grain adds no new public executable authority.

include: provider-private deterministic descendant-producing Windows qualification fixture
Job active-process accounting after primary-process exit
Job termination when descendants keep the process tree or inherited pipe handles alive past the bounded drain window
verified zero active Job processes before final success or destructive classification
fail-closed TerminationUnverified when descendant termination or quiescence cannot be proven
race-safe completion precedence between primary exit, pipe EOF, output-limit events, timeout, and descendant quiescence
SG-000009, SG-000009A, and SG-000010 regression coverage
exclude: approval bypass or persistent approval reuse

authority_delta.process: No new public process authority; provider-private lifecycle hardening and deterministic native qualification only
authority_delta.secrets: None; existing sanitized child environment boundary is retained

invariants: SG-000010 public Windows process.spawn remains restricted to the exact qualified System32 whoami.exe target
Primary-process exit alone is not sufficient evidence of process-tree completion
A descendant retaining stdout or stderr cannot cause an unbounded reader join or unbounded successful request
Post-primary-exit draining is bounded by an explicit internal deadline
If descendant processes remain active after the bounded drain window, the Job is terminated and zero active processes must be verified
A success result is returned only when the primary exit is known, required output readers have reached a bounded terminal state, and Job active-process count is zero
Failure to prove descendant termination or Job quiescence returns TerminationUnverified and never success
Output-limit and timeout semantics remain fail-closed and do not get downgraded by a concurrent primary exit
No additional executable, shell, PowerShell, network, background, public kill, browser/UI, elevation, or approval authority is introduced

acceptance.claim: A native Windows provider-private fixture whose primary process exits while a descendant retains stdout/stderr handles completes within a deterministic bound and cannot hang the executor.
When a descendant remains active beyond the bounded post-primary-exit drain window, Cotra terminates the Job and verifies zero active Job processes before returning the final typed result.

If descendant termination or zero-active-process verification cannot be proven, the executor returns TerminationUnverified and never success, ProcessTimeout, or OutputLimit as a stronger claim than the evidence permits.

Race-focused tests establish deterministic precedence across primary exit, stdout/stderr EOF, output-limit events, timeout, Job termination, and quiescence verification without unbounded joins or sleeps as the synchronization contract.

The fixed descendant fixture remains AppContainer-contained, is assigned to the kill-on-close Job before resume, uses only the existing three inherited standard handles and sanitized environment, and has network_class=NONE.
SG-000009, SG-000009A, and SG-000010 native Windows success/timeout/output-limit/TerminationUnverified/public-whoami regressions remain green, and no new public executable target is authorized.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, and security review gates pass with zero unresolved blocking findings.

done_when: Descendant-retained-stdio post-primary-exit behavior is bounded and natively qualified, Job/process-tree quiescence is verified before success, uncertainty fails closed as TerminationUnverified, existing public process.spawn authority does not widen, and the implementation is merged with post-merge verification.
